programme.desc: Elphaba, the Wicked Witch of the West, must reunite with Glinda the Good to transform herself - and Oz - for good.

programme.title: Look Who's Talking
programme.desc: Smash-hit comedy following a single mother on her search for the perfect husband and father to baby Mikey (voiced by Bruce Willis). With John Travolta. Strong language.

programme.title: Look Who's Talking Too
programme.desc: Roseanne Barr voices the new addition to Kirstie Alley and John Travolta's family, and is just as opinionated as her toddler brother, voiced by Bruce Willis. Comedy sequel.

programme.title: Look Who's Talking Now
programme.desc: Danny DeVito and Diane Keaton voice the new pets of couple Kirstie Alley and John Travolta, and their take on the world makes for some eye-opening insights. Sex references.

programme.title: Journey 2: The Mysterious Island
programme.desc: After intercepting a cryptic radio message, intrepid Josh Hutcherson and stepdad Dwayne Johnson set off across the Pacific on a magical voyage of discovery. Flashing images.

programme.title: Jumanji
programme.desc: A man trapped inside a magical boardgame is freed with a zoo-full of rampaging jungle beasts. Wild fantasy adventure with Robin Williams.

programme.title: The Karate Kid Part II
programme.desc: High-kicking karate student Daniel and his mentor Mr Miyagi travel to Japan to settle an old score. Family action sequel with Pat Morita and Ralph Macchio.

programme.title: The Karate Kid Part III
programme.desc: Hothead Daniel dumps Mr Miyagi for a new coach. But without his ally, can the youngster defeat the toxic waste baron who is training an old enemy? Mild violence.

programme.title: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
programme.desc: Dr Kelson finds himself in a shocking new relationship with consequences that could change the world as he knows it. Horror sequel, starring Ralph Fiennes, Jack O'Connell and Alfie Williams.

programme.title: Halloween
programme.desc: Four decades ago, Michael Myers terrorised the town of Haddonfield, Illinois and went on a killing spree, 15 years after murdering his sister. After a prison bus crashes, the killer is back in the wild, but survivor Laurie Strode is ready for his return. Director David Gordon Green's horror sequel based on John Carpenter's much imitated 1978 namesake movie, starring Jamie Lee Curtis, Judy Greer and Andi Matichak.

programme.title: Sinners
programme.desc: Hoping to escape their troubled pasts, twin brothers return to their hometown to start over, only to find an even darker force waiting to welcome them back. Writer/director Ryan Coogler's Oscar-winning horror thriller, starring Michael B Jordan, Miles Caton and Saul Williams.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn
programme.desc: A crook and his unhinged brother take a preacher's family hostage and cross the border into Mexico. They head to a rough strip club to make a planned rendezvous with a third party - but they soon have to live on their wits when they realise that the establishment's staff are vampires. Horror, starring George Clooney, Harvey Keitel, Quentin Tarantino, Juliette Lewis and Salma Hayek.

programme.title: Opus
programme.desc: A writer travels to the remote compound of pop star Alfred Moretti, where she discovers the twisted plans of his cult. Writer/director Mark Anthony Green's thriller, starring Ayo Edebiri, John Malkovich and Juliette Lewis.

programme.title: Presence
programme.desc: A family become convinced they are not alone after moving into their new home in the suburbs. Steven Soderbergh's horror thriller, starring Lucy Liu, Chris Sullivan, Callina Liang and Eddy Maday.

programme.title: Until Dawn
programme.desc: A year after their friend disappeared, a group find themselves trapped in a time loop, where they are hunted and killed unless they survive until dawn. Video game-inspired horror, starring Ella Rubin, Michael Cimino and Odessa A'zion.

programme.title: 28 Years Later
programme.desc: Decades since the rage virus took hold, the survivors live on a small island. When one of the group leaves on a mission into the mainland, he discovers secrets, wonders, and horrors that have mutated not only the infected but other survivors. Danny Boyle's horror thriller sequel, starring Jodie Comer, Aaron Taylor-Johnson, Ralph Fiennes and Rocco Haynes.

programme.title: It
programme.desc: In the summer of 1989, a group of bullied kids band together to destroy a shape-shifting monster, which disguises itself as a clown and preys on the children of their small New England town. Part one of a two-part Horror based on the Stephen King novel, starring Bill Skarsgard, Jaeden Lieberher and Sophia Lillis.

programme.title: Five Nights At Freddy's 2
programme.desc: One year after the supernatural nightmare at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, Mike and Vanessa are pulled back into a terrifying series of events. Horror sequel, starring Josh Hutcherson and Elizabeth Lail.

programme.title: Get Out
programme.desc: After African American photographer Chris and his white girlfriend Rose visit her wealthy parents, he suspects there's more to the locals than meets the eye. Oscar-winning psychological thriller written and directed by Jordan Peele (Us), starring Daniel Kaluuya, Allison Williams, Bradley Whitford and Caleb Landry Jones.

programme.title: Sinners
programme.desc: Hoping to escape their troubled pasts, twin brothers return to their hometown to start over, only to find an even darker force waiting to welcome them back. Writer/director Ryan Coogler's Oscar-winning horror thriller, starring Michael B Jordan, Miles Caton and Saul Williams.

programme.title: Black Phone 2
programme.desc: Four years after a serial killer prowled the streets of North Denver, posing as a magician to lure unsuspecting children into the back of his van, teenager Finney tries to adjust to a normal life. However, the lethal Grabber returns, and is bent on revenge. Horror thriller, starring Ethan Hawke and Mason Thames.

programme.title: Evil Dead
programme.desc: Five friends travel to a remote woodland cabin, hoping one of them can conquer her drug addiction by going cold turkey. They uncover a mysterious book that, when read, unleashes demonic forces that possess the living and transform them into bloodthirsty zombies. Horror remake, starring Jane Levy and Shiloh Fernandez.

programme.title: Evil Dead Rise
programme.desc: Guitar technician Beth abandons life on tour to visit her estranged sister Ellie and three children, Bridget, Danny and Kassie. A 5.5 magnitude earthquake rocks the city, causing structural failures in the basement that expose an old bank vault and a copy of the Naturom Demonto. Horror, starring Alyssa Sutherland.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn 2: Texas Blood Money
programme.desc: A bank robber is bitten by a vampire, spelling trouble for his partners in crime, who find themselves trapped in their hideout with a bloodsucking terror. Horror sequel, starring Robert Patrick, Bo Hopkins, Duane Whitaker, Muse Watson and Tiffani-Amber Thiessen.

programme.title: Pet Sematary
programme.desc: Massachusetts doctor Louis Creed moves to a small Maine town with his wife Rachel, their kids, Ellie and Gage, and Church, the cat. While exploring the local woods, Ellie stumbles across a funeral procession of children taking a dead dog to a cemetery. Neighbour Jud Crandall warns the Creeds that the woods are dangerous, as they soon discover for themselves via the dark power of the local burial ground. Horror based on the Stephen King novel, starring Jason Clarke, Amy Seimetz and John Lithgow.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Revenge
programme.desc: Some films are best served cold, so wrap up and join us as we dive into our favourite revenge movies - from new hits to Oscar-winning classics. We hope you're ready for action.

programme.title: Wolf Man
programme.desc: After a family barricade themselves inside their remote farmhouse when a creature attacks, a father slowly transforms into something unrecognisable. Werewolf horror from The Invisible Man director Leigh Whannell, starring Christopher Abbott, Julia Garner, Matilda Firth and Sam Jaeger.

programme.title: It
programme.desc: In the summer of 1989, a group of bullied kids band together to destroy a shape-shifting monster, which disguises itself as a clown and preys on the children of their small New England town. Part one of a two-part Horror based on the Stephen King novel, starring Bill Skarsgard, Jaeden Lieberher and Sophia Lillis.

programme.title: Five Nights At Freddy's 2
programme.desc: One year after the supernatural nightmare at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, Mike and Vanessa are pulled back into a terrifying series of events. Horror sequel, starring Josh Hutcherson and Elizabeth Lail.

programme.desc: After African American photographer Chris and his white girlfriend Rose visit her wealthy parents, he suspects there's more to the locals than meets the eye. Oscar-winning psychological thriller written and directed by Jordan Peele (Us), starring Daniel Kaluuya, Allison Williams, Bradley Whitford and Caleb Landry Jones.

programme.title: The Bride!
programme.desc: In 1930s Chicago, maverick scientist Dr Euphronius gives life to a murdered woman, sparking romance, police interest and radical change. Writer/director Maggie Gyllenhaal's horror based on The Bride of Frankenstein, starring Jessie Buckley, Christian Bale and Annette Bening.

programme.title: The Conjuring: Last Rites
programme.desc: Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren take on one last terrifying case involving mysterious entities they must confront. Supernatural mystery drama, starring Vera Farmiga, Patrick Wilson and Elliot Cowan.

programme.title: The Shining
programme.desc: A writer takes a caretaking job at a remote mountain hotel. It has closed for the winter, and he has been hired to get the place ready for the next season. But evil spirits haunting its corridors destroy his sanity, causing the unhinged author to rampage through the hotel and terrorise his wife and young son. Stanley Kubrick's horror, based on the Stephen King novel, with Jack Nicholson, Shelley Duvall, Danny Lloyd and Scatman Crothers.

programme.title: Halloween
programme.desc: Four decades ago, Michael Myers terrorised the town of Haddonfield, Illinois and went on a killing spree, 15 years after murdering his sister. After a prison bus crashes, the killer is back in the wild, but survivor Laurie Strode is ready for his return. Director David Gordon Green's horror sequel based on John Carpenter's much imitated 1978 namesake movie, starring Jamie Lee Curtis, Judy Greer and Andi Matichak.

programme.title: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
programme.desc: Dr Kelson finds himself in a shocking new relationship with consequences that could change the world as he knows it. Horror sequel, starring Ralph Fiennes, Jack O'Connell and Alfie Williams.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn 3: The Hangman's Daughter
programme.desc: Prequel to the acclaimed horror tale, in which a band of Western outlaws and unfortunate travellers stumble across a remote bar inhabited by suspicious looking characters _ who turn out to be vampires. Marco Leonardi, Michael Parks and Temuera Morrison star.

programme.title: Wolf Man
programme.desc: After a family barricade themselves inside their remote farmhouse when a creature attacks, a father slowly transforms into something unrecognisable. Werewolf horror from The Invisible Man director Leigh Whannell, starring Christopher Abbott, Julia Garner, Matilda Firth and Sam Jaeger.

programme.title: Rabbit Trap
programme.desc: Married musicians Daphne and Darcy Davenport moved from London to a cottage in Wales to complete their new album. By accident they record a mystical sound never heard before, and gradually disconnect from reality. Writer/director Bryn Chainey's horror, starring Dev Patel and Rosy McEwen.

programme.title: Night Patrol
programme.desc: An LA cop discovers a local task force is hiding a secret that puts the residents of his childhood neighbourhood in danger. Director Ryan Prows' horror thriller, starring Jermaine Fowler and Justin Long.

programme.title: Man Finds Tape
programme.desc: After finding mysterious video clips, siblings investigate the strange recordings and uncover a disturbing secret. Horror thriller, starring Kelsey Pribilski and William Magnuson.

programme.title: Beast of War
programme.desc: A group of soldiers get stranded on a raft in the middle of the ocean after their ship is sunk, and must battle a great white shark. Writer/director Kiah Roache-Turner's horror thriller, starring Mark Coles Smith and Joel Nankervis.

programme.title: Pet Sematary
programme.desc: Massachusetts doctor Louis Creed moves to a small Maine town with his wife Rachel, their kids, Ellie and Gage, and Church, the cat. While exploring the local woods, Ellie stumbles across a funeral procession of children taking a dead dog to a cemetery. Neighbour Jud Crandall warns the Creeds that the woods are dangerous, as they soon discover for themselves via the dark power of the local burial ground. Horror based on the Stephen King novel, starring Jason Clarke, Amy Seimetz and John Lithgow.

programme.title: Nosferatu
programme.desc: In 1838 Germany, Thomas Hutter is sent to the Carpathian mountains to secure the signature of enigmatic nobleman Count Orlok on a property sale in the German city of Wisborg. Thomas leaves his bride Ellen in the care of friend Friedrich Harding and his wife Anna. The young man barely survives the exhausting trip to Europe and stumbles home to find Ellen driven to delirium by a telepathic bond to the Count. Director Robert Eggers' version of the Dracula-inspired horror, starring Bill Skarsgard, Lily-Rose Depp, Nicholas Hoult and Aaron Taylor-Johnson.

programme.title: The Conjuring: Last Rites
programme.desc: Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren take on one last terrifying case involving mysterious entities they must confront. Supernatural mystery drama, starring Vera Farmiga, Patrick Wilson and Elliot Cowan.

programme.title: Insidious: The Last Key
programme.desc: A parapsychologist returns to her family home to investigate supernatural disturbances. Fourth instalment in the horror saga, starring Lin Shaye, Angus Sampson, Leigh Whannell and Spencer Locke.

programme.title: Get Out
programme.desc: After African American photographer Chris and his white girlfriend Rose visit her wealthy parents, he suspects there's more to the locals than meets the eye. Oscar-winning psychological thriller written and directed by Jordan Peele (Us), starring Daniel Kaluuya, Allison Williams, Bradley Whitford and Caleb Landry Jones.

programme.title: Lee Cronin's The Mummy
programme.desc: The young daughter of a journalist disappears into the desert without trace. Eight years later, the broken family is shocked when she is returned to them. Supernatural horror, starring Jack Reynor, Laia Costa, May Calamawy and Natalie Grace.

programme.title: Bring Her Back
programme.desc: Seventeen-year-old Andy and his visually impaired younger stepsister Piper discover their father dead in the shower. Single mother Laura agrees to take in Andy and Piper until the traumatised youngster comes of age and can apply for legal guardianship of his stepsister. Hoever, when events inside Laura's home spiral out of control, Andy fears he is losing his mind. Thriller, starring Billy Barratt, Sora Wong and Sally Hawkins.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: A young bank robber gets a job on the Ponderosa to prevent the sheriff from finding the other members of his gang.

programme.title: Woman on the Run
programme.desc: After witnessing a murder, Frank Johnson goes on the run to avoid being killed himself. His wife, Eleanor (Ann Sheridan), seems almost apathetic about finding him when questioned by Investigator Harris (Robert Keith), due to a marriage on the rocks. However, after learning that Frank has a grave heart condition, Eleanor recruits reporter Dan Leggett (Dennis O'Keefe) to help track down Frank. Discovering new love for her husband along the way, Eleanor must get to Frank before the killer does.

programme.desc: San Francisco businessman Harry Graham (Edmond O'Brien) and his wife and business partner, Eve (Joan Fontaine), are in the process of adopting a child. Reuniting with the trainer who once made him a legend, he commits to one final showdown against the reigning title-holder: a brutal fighter determined to dismantle the ex-champ's legacy in front of the world. Pushed to his breaking point, the contender's stakes are simple: win, or lose everything he's built.

programme.title: Death Race
programme.desc: Framed for a murder he did not commit, three-time speedway champ Jensen Ames (Jason Statham) finds himself at Terminal Island, the country's toughest prison, but he gets an unexpected chance at freedom when the warden offers a choice: Compete in the Death Race as a mythical driver called Frankenstein, or rot in a cell forever. Riding in a car equipped with flamethrowers and grenade launchers, Ames must survive a gauntlet of vicious criminals to win his freedom -- or die trying.

programme.title: The Red Stallion
programme.desc: Elderly Aggie Curtis is in financial trouble and must come up with cash or sell the horse ranch she runs with her orphaned grandson, Joel. programme.title: Tumbleweed Trail

With Bill left for dead, Brad and corrupt lawyer Alton Small (Ted Adams) produce a forged will that disinherits Bill's teenage daughter, Robin (Shirley Patterson), and son Freckles (Johnny McGovern). Aid arrives in the form of cowboys Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), who help Robin fight for her rightful property.

programme.title: Don Ricardo Returns
programme.desc: Two years after being forcibly taken away from his California property by thugs working for his greedy cousin, Luerra (Anthony Warde), Don Ricardo (Fred Coby) returns to reclaim his ranch and his fiancée, Dorothea (Isabelita). After meeting old friend Lugo the Huge (Paul Newlan) in a cantina, Don Ricardo takes the advice of Padre Carlos (David Leonard) and gets a job on his land, disguised as a common laborer, biding his time until he can find evidence of Luerra's wrongdoing and challenge him.

programme.title: Panhandle
programme.desc: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown.

programme.title: Terror in a Texas Town
programme.desc: When Swedish-American whaler George Hansen returns to his Texas hometown after 20 years at sea, he's shocked to learn that his father was murdered just two days prior. The feckless local sheriff won't do anything about it, so George investigates on his own and discovers that an oil speculator had his father killed for refusing to sell his land at an unfair price. Enraged, and armed only with a speargun, George goes looking for justice.

programme.title: Tornado Range
programme.desc: U.S. Marshal Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and his partner, Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), escort homesteaders into Texas to settle. Determined to resist the settlement, rancher Lance King (George Chesebro) organizes the locals, despite both the caution of his daughter, Mary (Jennifer Holt), and a government document delivered by Eddie assuring the homesteaders of their rights. As confrontation brews, criminal rancher Thayer (Terry Frost) uses the conflict as a cover to seek vengeance on King.

programme.title: The Trail Beyond
programme.desc: Fresh out of college, American Rod Drew (John Wayne) is asked to assist in the search for missing people in Canada. Accompanied by Wabi (Noah Beery Jr.), his friend from school, Drew travels north, but quickly gets into a confrontation with a gang of French Canadian outlaws. When the bandits abduct the young Felice Newsome (Verna Hillie), it becomes apparent they're responsible for the other disappearances as well. Luckily, Drew and Wabi are there, determined to find and free the captives.

programme.title: In Old Amarillo
programme.desc: A villainous cannery owner tries to foil efforts to get water to cattle ranchers during a severe drought.

programme.title: Sagebrush Trail
programme.desc: Wrongly imprisoned for murder, John Brant (John Wayne) decides his only option is to escape from jail and clear his name by finding the true killer. After breaking out, he ends up on the run from Sheriff Parker (Bob Burns) and catches the attention of outlaw Bob Jones (Lane Chandler), who offers to let Brant into his gang. Needing all the help he can get, Brant agrees, but running with these bandits only gets him deeper into trouble -- while the real killer remains on the loose.

programme.title: Under California Stars
programme.desc: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom.

programme.title: West of the Divide
programme.desc: Cowpoke Ted Hayden (John Wayne) infiltrates a band of outlaws in order to get close to their ringleader, Mr. Gentry (Lloyd Whitlock) -- the man who murdered his father. Joining Hayden on his mission is his dim but devoted companion, Dusty (George "Gabby" Hayes). But their plan gets complicated when Hayden meets Fay (Virginia Brown Faire), the lovely daughter of rancher Fred Winters (Lafe McKee). Gentry is after the man's land, and he wants Hayden to kill him to get it.

programme.title: Little Big Horn
programme.desc: Captain Phillip Donlin (Lloyd Bridges) and his small troop must rush to reach Little Big Horn in order to warn General Custer of the Sioux attack that awaits him. As they race against time, and Donlin pushes them hard through an arduous and dangerous journey, the Sioux start taking out the soldiers one at a time. Meanwhile, Donlin also clashes with Lt. John Haywood (John Ireland), who Donlin knows is having an affair with his wife, Celie (Marie Windsor).

programme.title: Rimfire
programme.desc: An undercover Army captain (James Millican) links missing gold and murder to a gambler's (Reed Hadley) ghost.

programme.title: Panhandle
programme.desc: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown.

programme.title: Shotgun
programme.desc: A deputy sheriff (Sterling Hayden) seeks justice with a woman (Yvonne De Carlo), a bounty hunter (Zachary Scott) and a sawed-off shotgun.

programme.title: The Magnificent Matador
programme.desc: An aging matador (Anthony Quinn) faces fear as he loves a rich American (Maureen O'Hara) and guides his son (Manuel Rojas) in the bullring.

programme.title: Fighting Man of the Plains
programme.desc: Gunslinger and former Confederate Jim Dancer (Randolph Scott) is on a mission to find his brother's killer but mistakenly shoots the wrong man, leading him to become an outlaw. Later, Dancer takes on the identity of a deceased marshal and comes into conflict with a ruthless band of criminals but receives help from a renowned old war buddy. Dancer also finally gets a chance to face off against his sibling's real murderer, Bert Slocum (Barry Kelley), in a tense showdown.
